answer: Each identity seeds an ember at admission, a key-bound chain. Every epoch the beacon passes through a prism yielding one challenge per band; each identity extends its ember with its band value through a memory-hard step holding a 2 GB working set and anchors the head at the summit checkpoint within 10 minutes. Checkers replay any chain against the beacon record; a wrong band value or one missed epoch kills the ember, resetting tenure to zero. An honest agent tends one ember; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 chains tended every epoch, 32 machines per window, and no gap can be precomputed or repaired.
